comparison.objective: Mount and aim two cardioid microphones on a stereo bar in an ORTF arrangement.
comparison.physical_skill: Dual-device mounting with controlled spacing, angle, and common aiming.
comparison.success_condition: Two microphones form an ORTF pair aimed at the choir; body omits numeric spacing, angle, and fastening tolerances.
comparison.reason: Multi-object geometric rigging and aiming are different from fracture-producing impact work and debris recovery.
